summary: Announces that the network address of MIT-Multics would change from 6 to 44 on a Monday in December 1973, as a second MIT IMP came into use. Sites were asked to update their tables and programs.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 590 tells network users that MIT-Multics planned to change its address from 6 to 44. It explains why the move was planned and asks users to update their address tables and programs.

questions: why did mit multics change its network address
what was the new mit multics address
subtitle: Notice of a planned change to the MIT-Multics network address.

tldr.problem: The existing MIT IMP had several uses competing for its ports and four very active hosts, and MIT wanted to make a second IMP available.
tldr.mechanism: MIT-Multics was scheduled to change its network address from 6 to 44, with users asked to update their tables and programs.
tldr.outcome: The RFC gives the planned changeover date and says one or two test sessions might occur beforehand.

today: RFC 590 is a 1973 operational notice about a planned change to the MIT-Multics network address.

sections.title: A New MIT-Multics Address
sections.content: The RFC announces that MIT-Multics would change its network address from 6 to 44 (decimal) on Monday, December 17, 1973. It asks users to make the necessary changes to their tables and programs by then.
sections.plainLanguage: MIT-Multics planned to use a new network address. Users needed to update any tables or programs that referred to its old address.

sections.title: Why the Address Was Changing
sections.content: The RFC gives three reasons for the change: the four ports on IMP 6 had some nine uses; a second MIT IMP was desirable; and IMP 6 already served four very active hosts, making it desirable to move at least one to a less busy IMP. The new Multics machine was about 2,000 feet from the old IMP, making it the logical candidate for the move.
sections.plainLanguage: MIT wanted another IMP because the existing one was busy. The new Multics machine's location also made it a suitable host to move.

sections.title: Testing Before the Changeover
sections.content: The announcement says one or two test sessions on the new IMP were likely before the changeover. MIT would announce them in its message of the day. They would temporarily affect users who could not use numeric host addresses directly.
sections.plainLanguage: MIT planned test sessions before the address change and would announce them to users. The note says the tests would temporarily affect people unable to use numeric host addresses directly.
